### 1. what the user expresses; simulator mode

Target object: booking AHLU26NGB152718 ("calling about booking AHLU26NGB152718 out of Ningbo"). Action: goodwill waiver of the charge for the second move to a later sailing ("You would like the charge for the second move waived as a goodwill gesture … That waiver is the one thing you are calling about"). Timing: today ("you want it done today"). Authorisation: agent acts ("you are happy for the agent to put it through on your behalf"). The customer does not know the amount and never mentions the August destination change on her own. The simulator is passive: it supplies identity details, the container count (three; oxidizer containers turned down) and contract status only when asked, and agrees conditionally to the destination-change charge only "if the agent tells you" about it. No user-owned tool exists in this task (user tool list holds only call_user_discoverable_tool, nothing is handed over).

### 2. act now / wait / refuse, and eligibility grounds

Act now. Grounds, all visible:
- status confirmed: booking_amendments "any amendment charge are accepted only on a booking whose status is confirmed or equipment released"; customer_roll_fee_charging "on condition that the booking remains open to amendment charges"; destination_change_fee_charging "provided the booking is still in a state that accepts amendment charges".
- the roll fee debt exists though unbooked: customer_roll_fee_charging "The debt dates from the day of the roll itself, and it stands even if nobody booked the fee that day. A roll left without its fee is accordingly charged when the booking next comes up for handling".
- goodwill conditions after the account is put in order (see item 4): entry amount 225.00 is >0 and within AHL Contract Booking's "Largest fee entry the desk may waive" 250.00 (goodwill_waiver_limits, goodwill_amount_ceiling); quota: waivers in the 365 days ending 2026-09-09 = 1 (2025-11-14), below the product quota 2 (goodwill_fee_waivers "counted across every booking of the customer … The comparison uses the quota of the product of the booking that carries the fee"); request period: entry date = today, 0 days <= 45 (goodwill_request_window "from the entry date of the customer roll fee entry addressed"); once per entry: no waiver yet; contract: shortfall_balance 0.00 (goodwill_contract_shortfall "available only if the contract's shortfall balance stands at exactly 0.00"); change account complete once both fees are booked (change_account_completeness).
Nothing waits on goods, time or review.

### 3. narrowest object, correlation keys, rows in/out

- Booking 27740ead-… only. The other booking 2c1a9cd1-… is excluded from every charge ("every booking keeps a separate charge account", concurrent_bookings) but its waiver entry of 2025-11-14 is included in the goodwill quota count (quota is counted across every booking of the customer).
- Customer rolls: the two roll_notice rows with roll_initiator customer (9945af8c-…, e7201e29-…). Carrier rolls: none.
- Destination changes: the one amendment_log row with amendment_type pod_change (cf174a03-…).
- Chargeable containers: booking quantity 5 less the single rejected acceptance ca9147cf-… (2) = 3; the approved acceptance (3) does not reduce anything (customer_roll_fee_containers case "one approved and one rejected … the approved acceptance does not reduce the count").
- Freight/surcharge/manual booking fee lines are excluded from goodwill (freight_and_surcharge_billing "None of these lines … is ever eligible for a goodwill waiver").

### 4. scored parameters: formula, inputs, value

(a) Customer roll fee (owed, unbooked):
- customer rolls = 2; product free customer rolls = 1 (roll_compensation_and_customer_roll_terms, AHL Contract Booking "75.00 | 1 | 3"); rolls owing = 2 - 1 = 1; less customer_roll_fee entries 0 -> 1 still owing (customer_rolls_beyond_allowance).
- the roll owing is the most recent customer roll ("The rolls still owing a fee are the booking's most recent customer rolls"), i.e. roll_notice e7201e29-… dated 2026-09-05; vessel_voyage = the sailing that roll took the booking off, verbatim "AHL ALSTER TRADER 615W".
- amount = 75.00 x 3 counted containers = 225.00, rounded once (customer_roll_fee_amount). The retired whole-quantity basis (75.00 x 5 = 375.00) is excluded by vessel_rolls "Charging a customer roll beyond the free allowance at the product's per-container customer roll fee multiplied by the whole container quantity is no longer in force".
(b) Change-of-destination fee (owed, unbooked):
- pod_change log entries 1 less pod_change_fee entries 0 = 1 owing (destination_changes_awaiting_fee).
- product permits destination change: AHL Contract Booking "yes | 300.00" (amendment_and_destination_change_terms).
- amount = 300.00 x 3 chargeable containers = 900.00 (destination_change_fee_amount + destination_change_fee_containers); independent of the free amendment allowance ("The free amendment allowance has no bearing on this fee"); the retired whole-quantity basis (1500.00) excluded by booking_amendments "Clause no longer in force".
- vessel_voyage = the sailing on the pod_change log entry, verbatim "AHL ELBE EXPRESS 614W", not today's sailing (destination_changes_awaiting_fee "which may differ from the sailing the booking holds today").
(c) Goodwill waiver:
- fee entry addressed = the most recent customer_roll_fee entry by entry date (goodwill_fee_entry_identification) = the entry booked in (a) today; amount 225.00.
- waiver_usd = 225.00 (goodwill_grant_combination "the waiver amount is the amount of the fee entry addressed, rounded to two decimal places"); reference_event_id = that new entry's booking_event_id (receipt of the charge); customer_id = ea30e93a-….
- terminal outstanding: 0.00 + 225.00 + 900.00 - 225.00 = 900.00 (observed in replay).

### 5. executable tool sequence, owners, dependencies, terminal state

All agent-owned:
1. find_customers -> verify_customer_identity (phone + code; 2 matched).
2. find_bookings(booking_number) -> find_booking_charges(booking) -> find_dg_acceptances(booking) -> find_service_contracts(contract) -> find_booking_charges(customer) for the quota.
3. unlock + call charge_customer_roll_fee_5e1ab19d {booking_id, vessel_voyage "AHL ALSTER TRADER 615W", fee_usd 225.00}.
4. unlock + call charge_destination_change_fee_9814adc0 {booking_id, vessel_voyage "AHL ELBE EXPRESS 614W", fee_usd 900.00}.
5. unlock + call waive_customer_roll_fee_66cbaf18 {booking_id, customer_id, reference_event_id = booking_event_id returned in step 3, waiver_usd 225.00}.
Dependencies: 5 needs 3 (the entry must exist and its id is the parameter) and 4 (completeness at the moment of the waiver). 3 and 4 are mutually independent (either order leaves the same account). Terminal state: booking still confirmed, sailing unchanged; three new entries dated 2026-09-09 (customer_roll_fee 225.00, pod_change_fee 900.00, waiver 225.00 -> the roll fee entry); charges_due_usd 900.00. Replay through rt_query returned waiver receipt {charge_code waiver, amount_usd 225.0, charges_due_usd 900.0}.

### 6. problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root P0: waive, as goodwill, the customer roll fee of the second customer roll.

Hop 1 — P0 depends on P1 "book the unbooked customer roll fee of the latest customer roll" (derived).
- Blocked-side principle: goodwill_fee_entry_identification "Goodwill acts on the record, not on a balance in the abstract. What a waiver cancels, the amount it carries and the date from which its request period runs are those of a customer roll fee entry that stands in the booking's charge history. An amount the booking merely owes, while no entry for it exists, gives a waiver nothing to cancel". customer_roll_fee_goodwill "A waiver cancels the fee entry in its entirety … refers to that fee entry".
- Depended-on rule: customer_roll_fee_charging "The debt dates from the day of the roll itself, and it stands even if nobody booked the fee that day. A roll left without its fee is accordingly charged when the booking next comes up for handling"; customer_rolls_beyond_allowance (count rule).
- Records: two customer roll_notice rows, free allowance 1, zero customer_roll_fee entries.
- Combination: the thing to waive does not exist; the rules say the debt exists and is booked at this handling; so book it, then the waiver has its entry. No single sentence states "charge the fee before waiving it". Findability: records say "roll_notice" / roll_initiator customer; KB words "roll notices that name the customer as the cause" (grep "roll notice" hits customer_rolls_beyond_allowance and change_account_completeness).
- Side note (for the implicitness scan, not a read-off): the phrase "An amount the booking merely owes, while no entry for it exists" in goodwill_fee_entry_identification and the waiver-tool parameter text "as shown in the charge history or in the receipt of the charge that booked it" point strongly toward the owed-but-unbooked case.

Hop 2 — P0 depends on P2 "book the unbooked change-of-destination fee of the August discharge-port change" (derived).
- Blocked-side principle: change_account_completeness "Goodwill on a Container Bookings customer roll fee is weighed only against a booking whose change account is complete … complete when every discharge-port change that owes a fee under its own rules has its change-of-destination fee entry on the charge history, and every customer roll that lies beyond the product's free customer rolls has its customer roll fee entry there too"; goodwill_grant_combination "fails one of the added ones, such as the completeness of the change account … receives no waiver".
- Depended-on rules: destination_change_fee_charging "The debt arises on the day the change was logged … charged at the next occasion on which the booking is handled"; destination_changes_awaiting_fee (count); destination_change_fee_containers + goodwill_rejected_dg_containers (3 chargeable > 0, so the change does owe a fee and does count against completeness).
- Records: one pod_change amendment_log row, zero pod_change_fee rows; product permits destination change.
- Combination: the account is incomplete; the only way it becomes complete is by booking the owed fee, which the charging rule says is due at this handling anyway. No sentence says "charge the destination fee before goodwill". The completeness condition itself is phrased as an eligibility condition of goodwill (a state), not as an ordering instruction; I mark the hop derived, but note that the completeness definition, joined to the charging clause, leaves little to combine (carried to the implicitness scan as a borderline item).
- Findability: records use "amendment_log … pod_change"; KB text "change of port of discharge", "discharge-port change", and the code `pod_change` in destination_change_fee_charging; KB_search "change of port of discharge fee pod_change amendment log" returns destination_changes_awaiting_fee, change_account_completeness, destination_change_fee_charging.

Hop 3 — P1 also closes the second half of completeness (the same booking of the roll fee satisfies "every customer roll that lies beyond … has its customer roll fee entry") (derived from the same completeness definition).

Hop 4 — P1 and P2 each depend on the DG-rejection count (chargeable/counted containers = 3) (derived: customer_roll_fee_containers, destination_change_fee_containers). This is a parameter dependency, not a separate action.

Handling order derived: {P1, P2} in either order, then P0. No further hop: no carrier roll (no compensation owed), SI/VGM not yet due, contract shortfall 0.00, quota not reached.

Wrong answer "do only the waiver": excluded — with no customer_roll_fee entry the waiver has nothing to reference (goodwill_fee_entry_identification "If the booking holds no customer roll fee entry at all, there is nothing to waive"); after booking only the roll fee, the change account is still incomplete (one pod_change without its fee) and goodwill_grant_combination says such an entry "receives no waiver". Wrong answer "refuse because there is no entry": excluded by customer_roll_fee_charging (debt stands, booked at next handling = now).

### two-way counter-proof (closest alternatives)

- Whole quantity 5 instead of 3 for either fee: excluded by the three "Clauses no longer in force" (vessel_rolls; booking_amendments) and by the current container rules; with 5 the roll fee (375.00) would exceed the 250.00 authority and flip the answer to refusal — the retired sentence explicitly rules this out.
- Charging the first customer roll (ELBE EXPRESS 614W) instead of the latest: excluded by "The rolls still owing a fee are the booking's most recent customer rolls" and the truth-table note "names the sailing shown on the third roll notice".
- Destination fee named on the current sailing (WESER BRIDGE 616W): excluded by destination_changes_awaiting_fee "the sailing shown on the port-of-discharge amendment log entry it settles … may differ from the sailing the booking holds today".
- Destination fee reduced to 0 by the amendment allowance (1st of 3 free): excluded by "The free amendment allowance has no bearing on this fee".
- Partial waiver or waiver of the destination fee too: excluded by "A waiver cancels the fee entry in its entirety and never a part of it" and the customer asking only for the roll charge.
- Quota exhausted because of the 2025 waiver: excluded — count 1 < quota 2 of AHL Contract Booking.
- Refusal for DG cargo: no visible rule bars goodwill for DG bookings; DG acceptances only change container counts.

### blind verdict (runtime)

A single solution is derivable from visible materials: book customer roll fee 225.00 on "AHL ALSTER TRADER 615W"; book change-of-destination fee 900.00 on "AHL ELBE EXPRESS 614W"; then waive the new roll fee entry for 225.00. All hops derived; two hops flagged as borderline for the implicitness scan.
